title: WebGPU realistic ocean water shader with floating objects (R3F)
description: Build a non-interactive realistic ocean water shader on React Three Fiber using the WebGPURenderer + TSL. Use Gerstner waves for geometric displacement, dual scrolling normal maps blended on top for surface micro-detail, Fresnel mixing for sky/deep-water color, environment HDR for reflections, and optional planar reflector. Place 3-5 floating objects (boats/buoys/ducks) whose Y position and tilt are sampled from the same Gerstner function each frame so they bob realistically. No mouse/pointer interactivity. Scaffolds the empty repo as Vite + React + TypeScript first.
close_reason: Shipped: WebGL three.js Water class (planar reflection) + drei Sky, driftwood floaters (crates/planks/branches with emissive lift), collapsible stats.js perf panel (Canvas-driven, top-left, safe-area). typecheck+build PASS. Bundle 1079KB/301KB gzip.
